  $t = $a.Value

  $texts = ([regex]::Matches($t, '<w:t(?:\s[^>]*)?>([^<]*)</w:t>') | ForEach-Object { $_.Groups[1].Value }) -join ''
  $cx = [regex]::Match($t, '<wp:extent cx="(\d+)" cy="(\d+)"').Groups
  $posH = [regex]::Match($t, '<wp:positionH relativeFrom="page"><wp:posOffset>(-?\d+)</wp:posOffset>').Groups[1].Value

  $sz = [regex]::Match($t, '<w:sz w:val="(\d+)"').Groups[1].Value
  $emu = 12700.0
  if ($cx.Success) {

}
